hooks.name: Release Manual-Only Guard
hooks.description: PreToolUse guard on the shell tool: an agent may validate a release but never cut one. Refuses scripts/release.sh without --dry-run, refuses --yes with or without it, and refuses the by-hand equivalent (creating or pushing a v<semver> tag) so the rule cannot be routed around via git. --dry-run is the expected agent action: it runs every gate and stops before the plan executes. Exists because v0.20.1 was cut by an agent with --yes and reached a pushed tag and a published GitHub release with five artifacts while carrying a red CI job and unreviewed code deletions; undoing it meant deleting a published release. Tag listing and deletion stay allowed, since undoing a bad tag needs them. Fails open on any internal error. Logic lives in .kiro/hooks/bin/release-manual-only-guard.sh.
